query: what do I know about pgvector for similarity search

seed_memories.content: What I know about pgvector for similarity search: pgvector adds a vector column type to PostgreSQL and supports IVFFlat plus HNSW indexes for approximate similarity search. The IVFFlat index needs to be built after data is loaded for the centroids to be representative, while HNSW indexes can be built incrementally.
seed_memories.summary: What I know about pgvector for similarity search: IVFFlat vs HNSW indexing.
